value: Shopify stores and AI shopping channels: public readiness check, October 2026

Nature of the sample
value: Stores that Shopify features as examples, not a random sample; no store is named and no row describes a single store

label: Study page with method and limits
How a store fails a rule
value: A rule fails for a store when at least one sampled product or page fails it; unknown means the evidence could not be read and counts neither as a pass nor as a gap

label: What items are
value: Items are what a rule was checked on, for example sampled products, product pages, policy pages or robots.txt paths, depending on the rule

label: What info means
value: Info marks an informational rule: its result is reported but does not change the store score

label: What base is
value: The base column holds the number of stores, products or pages that a count or a percent refers to

label: Rounding
value: Percent values are rounded to one decimal place, so a very small share can appear as 0

label: Where the sources are
value: The source column holds the documentation a rule is based on (filled on the weight row of each rule) or the Shopify page a group of store links came from

label: About the llms rule
value: The optional llms rule (weight 0) stays unknown for almost every store in this file because the evidence was read before the reader accepted llms.txt served as text/markdown; the llms_txt section reports the HTTP status and content type instead
